# Compare to other monthly gas series in the literature

```{r}
library(readxl)

save_compare <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/DATA/gas_news_data"
setwd(save_compare)
info_selected <- read_parquet("info_selected.parquet")
colnames(info_selected)

gas_data_tot <- read_excel("TTF_futures.xlsx")
gas_data_shock <- read_parquet("gas_data_shock.parquet")

gas_data_tot$dms_M1 <- log(gas_data_tot$DTFE1C.D7) - log(lead(gas_data_tot$DTFE1C.D7, 1))

info_selected <- info_selected %>%
    mutate(instrumented_day = ifelse(binary_shock == TRUE & news_per_day > 3, "supply_shock", 0),
           instrumented_day = ifelse(Date %in% demand_news_days, "demand_shock", instrumented_day))
 
info_selected <- left_join(info_selected, gas_data_tot %>% 
                                  select(time, dms_M1), by = c( "time"))

supply_shock_serie <- info_selected %>% 
  filter(instrumented_day=="supply_shock") %>% 
  mutate(month = month(Date), year= year(Date))%>%
  group_by(month, year) %>% 
  summarize(Value_PC1 = sum(PC1), Value_dms_M1= sum(dms_M1), Date = first(Date)) %>% 
  arrange(Date)


setwd('C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/DATA/gas_news_data')
events_data <- read.csv("alex_gassani_shocks.csv")
events_data <- events_data %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% 
  arrange(Date)
colnames(gas_data_shock)
gas_all <- merge(gas_data_shock, gas_data_tot, by="time")
alex_gassani_benchmark <- left_join( events_data, gas_all %>% 
                                      select(Date, dms_M1, PC1) ,
                                by = c("Date"))

events_data_serie <- alex_gassani_benchmark %>% 
  mutate(month = month(Date), year= year(Date))%>%
  group_by(month, year) %>% 
  summarize(Value_PC1_AG = sum(PC1), Value_dms_M1_AG = sum(dms_M1), Date = first(Date)) %>% 
  arrange(Date)
events_data_serie 
```



```{r}

shock_series_all <- full_join(supply_shock_serie ,events_data_serie%>% select(-Date),
                              by = c("month", 'year')) %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(year)> 2014)
# Convert "Month_Year" to Date format (assume 1st day of the month)
shock_series_all$Date <- as.Date(paste0(shock_series_all$year, "-",shock_series_all$month,  "-01"))


# Get the min and max dates
min_date <- min(shock_series_all$Date)
max_date <- max(shock_series_all$Date)

# Create a sequence of full months between min and max dates
months_seq <- seq(min_date, max_date, by = "month")

# Calculate the middle of each month (e.g., 15th day)
middle_dates <- as.Date(paste0(format(months_seq, "%Y-%m-01")))


shock_series_all <- left_join(tibble(Date = middle_dates), shock_series_all,  by = "Date")

# Remplir les NA avec 0
shock_series_all[is.na(shock_series_all)] <- 0

shock_series_all
  
```




```{r}
my_plot <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(data= shock_series_all, aes(x= as.POSIXct.Date(Date) , y= Value_PC1_AG, color='Alessandrini and Gazani'))+

  # geom_line(data= shock_series_all, aes(x= as.POSIXct.Date(Date) , y= Value_dms_M1_AG, color='Alessandrini and Gazani'), linetype = 'dashed')+
  # geom_line(data = shock_series_all, aes(x=as.POSIXct.Date(Date), y=Value_dms_M1, color='Gas news corpus measure'), linetype = 'dashed')+
  labs(title = 'Gas shocks',
      x = "Time") +
  geom_line(data=gas_data_tot[1:(nrow(gas_data_tot)-1500),], aes(x=time, y= DTFE1C.D7/100) )+

    name = "€/MW",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 100, name = "Shock Series")  # Adjust scaling factor if needed
  )

my_plot
```
